judgment.breakersFired: The rising-count tripwire never fired — findings fell monotonically (11/8/5/2/2). The OSCILLATION signal did, and was not acted on: rounds 3, 4 and 5 were 100% propagation (5/5, 2/2, 2/2), each one repairing an incomplete sweep left by the round before it, chasing the same two rules (the ledger carrier restriction and the stale-record sweep) through successive locations. working-modes.md names a round dominated by failures of the previous round's fixes as its own stopping condition precisely because prose cannot be executed; three consecutive such rounds is the pattern that rule exists to catch.

notes: Re-derived at the 2026-08-15 /maintenance ledger flush (Claude Code, Opus), NOT narrated in-session at loop close.
